summary.pack_description:
Get ‘em while they’re hot! The Base 2023-24 January Expansion features hard shots, highlight-reel clappers, and hometown heroics from Filip Hronek, Pavel Mintyukov, Connor Bedard, Steven Stamkos, Kris Letang, Tyler Seguin and more!

Each pack contains 2 Base 2023-24 highlights, plus 1 mystery highlight that could be from Base 2023-24, Opening Ice: Elites, Opening Ice 2023-24, or Cause for a Celly: ‘90s sets.

release.name: Base 2023-24 January Expansion Pack
release.description:
Sale Starts: Tue, Jan 2 at 5pm ET / 2pm PT

 

Price: $9 USD

# Packs Available: 5,000


Sweepstakes: Each pack purchased by Jan 7, 2024 at 11:59:59 p.m. ET is an entry for a chance to win a trip to the 2024 NHL® All-Star Game. Read the blog announcement and official rules (version Française). No purchase necessary to enter. Ends 11:59:59 p.m. ET on January 7th.

 

Purchase Limit: Ten (10) pack limit per person for the first 24 hours; limit increased to thirty (30) afterwards. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 3

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • Two (2) highlights from Base 2023-24 (Core #/1500)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 81% Base 2023-24 (Core #/1500)
    • 15% Opening Ice: Elites (Rare #/250)
    • 2% Opening Ice 2023-24 (Rare #/250)
    • 2% Cause for a Celly: ‘90s (Epic #/100)

 

Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be made via registered payment processor MoonPay where available; where not available, payments will be processed via Stripe.

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights are eligible to be sold to other collectors in the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace. A Marketplace Fee may be incurred upon resale. See FAQ.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights can be exchanged in the Trade Lounge™ with other NHL Breakaway users.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Full Highlights List
  • Base 2023-24, Series 1 - Preview
  • Opening Ice: Elites, Series 1 - Preview
  • Opening Ice: 2023-24, Series 1 - Preview
  • Cause for a Celly: ‘90s, Series 1 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 1 highlights will only be distributed during Series 1, which ends ~September 2024. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

summary.name: Opening Ice: Elites
summary.description: Introducing Opening Ice: Elites, an exhilarating set that captures the unforgettable moments when the game's current stars scored their first career NHL goal or a talented goalie secured his debut NHL victory. This exclusive collection showcases the raw talent and emotion of these rising stars as they etch their names in NHL history. Experience the sheer joy and determination as they find the back of the net or defend their crease in their milestone moments. Opening Ice: Elites is a celebration of the sport's future legends and a must-have addition to any hockey enthusiast's collection, cherishing the beginnings of remarkable careers.

summary.name: Opening Ice 2023-24
summary.description: Collect history with the first career goals from highly-anticipated 2023-24 rookies, including Connor Bedard, Logan Cooley, Leo Carlsson, Adam Fantilli, Matthew Poitras, Bobby Brink and more!

summary.name: Cause for a Celly: '90s
summary.description:
Cause For A Celly collection immortalizes many unforgettable NHL playoff moments that helped define the sport, featuring many of the game's greatest players and iconic instances that have left an indelible mark on hockey history.

Relive the exhilarating moments, featuring both legendary players and game or series-changing plays. From stunning overtime goals to game-saving glove saves, Cause For A Celly captures the drama, passion, and intensity of the playoffs like never before.

This exclusive set delves into the annals of NHL history, bringing to life the brilliance of great players and the unforgettable moments that have shaped the postseason.
